decision_table.name: Determine_ME_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file ME state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (factor presence standards).

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in ME (office, employees, property)

condition.name: has_economic_nexus
condition.comment: Meets ME economic nexus threshold (factor presence)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
ME filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: ME Form 1120ME Instructions Reference: 36 M.R.S. § 5200-B (Corporate income tax nexus)

ME filing required due to economic nexus (factor presence standards).
Nexus established if any of the following thresholds are exceeded: - $250,000 in Maine property - $250,000 in Maine payroll - $500,000 in Maine sales - 25% of total property, payroll, or sales in Maine
Reference: 36 M.R.S. § 5200-B (Corporate income tax nexus) Reference: ME Revenue Services Rule 808 (Corporate Income Tax Nexus)
No ME nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_ME_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate ME state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
ME state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction - Accelerated depreciation differences (federal vs ME) - Safe harbor lease deductions - Foreign dividends deduction addback
Subtractions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations (federal bonds) - Interest on Maine municipal bonds - Dividends from subsidiaries (95% deduction for 15%+ ownership) - Maine net operating loss deduction
Reference: ME Form 1120ME Schedule 1A (Additions) Reference: ME Form 1120ME Schedule 1S (Subtractions) Reference: 36 M.R.S. § 5200-A (Corporate income tax - computation)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_ME_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate ME state corporate income tax. Applies graduated tax rates to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

condition.name: income_tier

rule.policy:
ME state corporate income tax calculation - Tier 1: Income up to $350,000 taxed at 3.5%
Reference: ME Form 1120ME Instructions Reference: 36 M.R.S. § 5200-A (Corporate income tax rates)

ME state corporate income tax calculation - Tier 2: Income $350,000 to $1,050,000 - First $350,000 at 3.5% - Excess at 7.5%
Reference: ME Form 1120ME Instructions Reference: 36 M.R.S. § 5200-A (Corporate income tax rates)

ME state corporate income tax calculation - Tier 3: Income $1,050,000 to $3,500,000 - First $350,000 at 3.5% - Next $700,000 at 7.5% - Excess at 8.3%
Reference: ME Form 1120ME Instructions Reference: 36 M.R.S. § 5200-A (Corporate income tax rates)

ME state corporate income tax calculation - Tier 4: Income over $3,500,000 - First $350,000 at 3.5% - Next $700,000 at 7.5% - Next $2,450,000 at 8.3% - Excess at 8.93%
Reference: ME Form 1120ME Instructions Reference: 36 M.R.S. § 5200-A (Corporate income tax rates)
No ME nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.

No ME taxable income - no tax liability. ME NOL carryforward rules may apply.
Reference: 36 M.R.S. § 5200-A (Net operating loss deduction)
